'''The Big 4''' season 2 is a [[4on4]] event that takes place during February into spring [[2026]]. It is a continuation of season 1, but with a less traditionalist map pool, including phantombase, i.e the + in The Big 4 +.
Leaderboards, match reports, statistics and comments are run on the official website: [http://www.thebig4.se '''thebig4.se''']
